source: First-series Lambda: narrow-angle V4, 2121 cc, 49 PS (36 kW) at 3250 rpm; three-speed gearbox; four-wheel drum brakes (Wikipedia, citing Eckermann and others). Assumed: a droop to 3400 rpm no-load standing in for the throttle, ratios 3.4/1.9/1.0 with a 4.5 final drive (top gear about 104 km/h at rated speed; sources give 68-70 mph for later series), and the drum capacities.
brake_note: The pedal works all four drums through a mechanical linkage: 260 N m at each front drum and 300 N m at each rear, 1120 N m in all, about 0.25 g on level ground. The hand lever works the rear drums only.
